name: Whole-trajectory split-conformal quantile with fail-closed +infinity boundary

statement.latest: \text{Given calibration scores } A_{(1)}\le\cdots\le A_{(n)}: \quad r_\alpha=\lceil(n+1)(1-\alpha)\rceil,\quad q_\alpha=A_{(r_\alpha)}\text{ if }r_\alpha\le n,\quad q_\alpha=+\infty\text{ if }r_\alpha=n+1
statement.note_ascii: r_alpha = ceil((n+1)(1-alpha)); q_alpha = A_(r_alpha) if r_alpha<=n else +infinity (never clamped back to n)

origin.source: task-conditioned-6d-pose-stop, cqts/safety.py::safe_split_conformal_quantile (public, github.com/morrocwi/task-conditioned-6d-pose-stop); retroactive Toledo-first registration -- this equation was implemented and used before being registered

name: Whole-trajectory nonconformity score by max-aggregation over stages and coordinates

statement.note_ascii: A_j = max over K stages and 6 coordinates of the log-scaled nonconformity; used because the stopping stage is chosen adaptively, so per-stage independence cannot be assumed

parents.evidence: the input score consumed by PROP-CONF-01's quantile construction

note: This construction's conservativeness (the joint max over K x 6 = 90 cells inflates q_alpha strongly: exp(q)~7.4x observed empirically on BOP-LMO real data with K=15, n=40) is the diagnosed cause of a real falsifying result -- see GLS-2026-005 in glosa and lab/results/real-bop-lmo-2026-09-09{,-run2}/ in the source repo.

name: Bonferroni-corrected multi-checkpoint conformal band (union-bound whole-trajectory coverage without joint stage-aggregation)

statement.latest: \text{For checkpoint stages } k_1,\ldots,k_{K'}\text{ (predeclared, } K'\le n/(\lceil(n+1)(1-\alpha)\rceil\text{-feasibility bound):}\quad A_{j,k_m}=\max_{i\le6}[\log(|e_{j,k_m,i}|+\delta_i)-\log(s_{j,k_m,i})],\quad q_{k_m}=\text{SplitConformalQuantile}(\{A_{j,k_m}\}_{j=1}^n,\ \alpha/K').\quad \text{Then } P\Big(\bigcup_{m=1}^{K'} \{e^\star_{k_m}\notin \text{env}_{k_m}\}\Big) \le \sum_{m=1}^{K'}\alpha/K' = \alpha \text{ (union bound)}
statement.note_ascii: Bonferroni: calibrate each of K' predeclared checkpoint stages separately at level alpha/K' (coordinate-max only, no stage-aggregation), union bound over K' stages gives the same overall alpha-level whole-trajectory guarantee as the joint max-over-stages construction (PROP-CONF-01/02), without the multiplicative stage-count penalty inside a single max.

coq.print_assumptions_verbatim: both = Closed under the global context

parents.evidence: same quantile construction applied per-checkpoint instead of jointly over all stages
nonconformity score restricted to coordinate-max only, dropping the stage dimension of the max, at each of K' predeclared checkpoints

feasibility_constraint.statement: K' checkpoint stages are feasible only while ceil((n+1)(1-alpha/K')) <= n; computed for n=40, alpha=0.1: K'<=4 is feasible, K'=5 already forces q=+infinity at every checkpoint (verified by direct computation, see GLS-2026-005 diagnosis revision).

origin.source: New construction, designed 2026-09-09 to fix the diagnosed cause of two real-data falsifying results in task-conditioned-6d-pose-stop (GLS-2026-005). NOT YET IMPLEMENTED OR TESTED as of registration -- Toledo-first: registered before use, per the workspace's standing rule.
